_comment: Activates the EVM module's static precompiles (staking, distribution, ICS20
IBC transfer, bank, gov, slashing, bech32, p256, plus Ark's custom distrclaim)
which have been INACTIVE since genesis.
ROOT CAUSE: networks/devnet/genesis-template.json's evm.params block only
ever set evm_denom and extended_denom_options, leaving
active_static_precompiles as its zero value (empty list). The chain's own
Go code (app.go InitGenesis path, ~line 1302) DOES populate this list
correctly, but the live devnet's actual genesis.json (confirmed by reading
it directly off a running node) shows an empty list — the template-based
genesis generation used for this devnet bypassed that code path.
OBSERVED EFFECT: with active_static_precompiles empty,
IsAvailableStaticPrecompile() (x/vm/keeper/static_precompiles.go) returns
false for every static precompile address, so GetPrecompilesCallHook never
installs them into the EVM call. A call to 0x...0802 (ICS20) is then just a
call to a plain address with no code: it 'succeeds' at the EVM level,
consumes real gas at the cold-address-access rate, and does NOTHING — no
IBC packet, no error, no visible failure signal. Verified live: a real
transfer() call with 800,000 gas supplied consumed exactly 400,000 and
created zero IBC packets on either side of the channel (confirmed via both
the chain's own tx indexer and `hermes query packet pending`).
Dynamic precompiles (the auto-created ERC20 wrapper for each IBC/token-
factory denom) are NOT affected — those go through a completely separate,
ungated lookup path (erc20Keeper.GetERC20PrecompileInstance), which is why
ERC20 balance reads/transfers for KASH/OM have worked fine all along while
IBC-via-EVM-wallet silently did nothing.
MsgUpdateParams replaces the params struct wholesale — every field must be
present, not just the one being changed. Values below are the live devnet
params (queried via /cosmos/evm/vm/v1/params) with
active_static_precompiles corrected and nothing else changed.
Because this is a wholesale replace, submitting on a stale snapshot would
silently revert any field that changed on live devnet after this snapshot
was taken. Run verify-live-params.sh immediately before submitting to
confirm nothing else has drifted:
networks/devnet/proposals/verify-live-params.sh [lcd-url]
Submit:  arkd tx gov submit-proposal \
networks/devnet/proposals/activate-static-precompiles.json \
--from <key> --chain-id arkdevnet_9000-1 \
--gas auto --gas-adjustment 1.5 --gas-prices 1000000000esp
Verify:  arkd query evm params  (or GET /cosmos/evm/vm/v1/params)
FOLLOW-UP NEEDED (not done by this proposal): patch
networks/devnet/genesis-template.json's evm.params block to include this
same active_static_precompiles list, so a future devnet reset doesn't
reintroduce this bug from genesis.
metadata: Activate EVM static precompiles (staking/distribution/ICS20/bank/gov/slashing/bech32/p256/distrclaim), inactive since genesis
title: Activate EVM static precompiles, inactive since genesis
summary: active_static_precompiles has been empty since arkdevnet's genesis (a gap in the devnet genesis template, not the chain's Go defaults). This silently disables every static precompile including ICS20 (IBC-via-EVM-wallet transfers), staking, distribution, bank, gov, slashing, bech32, p256, and Ark's custom distrclaim precompile -- calls to these addresses succeed at the EVM level while doing nothing, with no visible error. This proposal activates the full correct list; a companion fix to the genesis template prevents recurrence on reset.
